en.name: Instant mashed potato
en.summary: A sealed box of instant potato flakes keeps 10–15 months from purchase in the cupboard, and 6–12 months once opened. The made-up mash is a different food: it is a wet cooked starch, and it belongs in the fridge within two hours.
en.pantry: Cool, dry and dark, 10–15 months from purchase while sealed and 6–12 months after opening. Dehydrated potato is stable because there is almost nothing in it for bacteria to use, so the failures are physical and chemical: humidity makes the flakes clump and then mould, and the small amount of fat and the added emulsifiers eventually go stale, which shows up as a cardboard taste in the finished mash. A cardboard box is not a seal — once the inner bag is open, clip it hard or decant the flakes into an airtight jar.
en.fridge: Dry flakes do not want the fridge; it is humid, and damp is the one thing that ends a packet. Keep them in a sealed jar in the cupboard instead. Made-up mashed potato is the part that needs refrigeration, and it needs it promptly: cooked potato is a low-acid, moist, starchy food, so get leftovers into a shallow covered container and into the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below within two hours of making them, or one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for instant potato flakes, and a dry good with a year or more in the cupboard gains little from the freezer beyond a risk of condensation when it comes out. Made-up mash does freeze reasonably well — better than mash made from fresh potatoes, because the emulsifiers hold it together — but treat that as a cooked dish rather than as this product, and cool it quickly before it goes in.
spoilage: Flakes clumped or caked together instead of pouring loose.
A stale, cardboard or faintly rancid smell when the bag is opened.
Mould spots or a musty smell in a bag that has taken up damp.
Insects, moths or webbing in the box.
tips: Decant the opened bag into an airtight jar; the box is not airtight.
Keep it off the shelf above the kettle — steam is the enemy.
Label the jar with the opening date; flakes give no obvious warning as they age.
Cool leftover mash in a shallow dish and refrigerate it within two hours.

faq.q: How long does instant mashed potato keep?
faq.a: 10–15 months from purchase while the pack is sealed, and 6–12 months once opened, kept dry and airtight.

faq.q: Do potato flakes need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No, and the fridge is too humid for them. Store them sealed in a cool dry cupboard.

faq.q: How long does made-up mashed potato keep?
faq.a: It is a cooked dish, not a pantry item. Cool it quickly, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below within two hours, and eat it within a few days.

zh.name: 即溶馬鈴薯泥粉
zh.summary: 未開封的即溶馬鈴薯泥粉從購買日起算放櫥櫃 10～15 個月，開封後 6～12 個月。沖泡好的薯泥則是另一種食物：那是含水的熟澱粉，必須在兩小時內進冰箱。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光：未開封自購買日起 10～15 個月，開封後 6～12 個月。脫水馬鈴薯之所以穩定，是因為裡面幾乎沒有細菌可用的東西，所以它的失敗是物理與化學性的：濕氣會讓薯片結塊、接著長霉；裡面少量的油脂與添加的乳化劑最終會走味，表現出來就是沖好的薯泥帶一股紙板味。紙盒不算密封——內袋一開，就要確實夾緊或倒進氣密罐。
zh.fridge: 乾的薯片不想進冰箱：那裡潮濕，而受潮正是唯一會終結一包的事。請改用密封罐放櫥櫃。真正需要冷藏的是沖好的薯泥，而且要快：熟馬鈴薯是低酸、含水的澱粉類食品，剩下的請裝進淺的加蓋容器，在做好後兩小時內放進 4 °C 以下的冰箱；如果室溫超過 32 °C，就縮短為一小時。
zh.freezer: 即溶薯泥粉沒有公布的冷凍期限，而一個能在櫥櫃放一年以上的乾貨，從冷凍得到的，除了拿出來時的結露風險之外也沒什麼。沖好的薯泥倒是冷凍得還不錯——甚至比新鮮馬鈴薯做的更好，因為乳化劑會把它撐住——但那要當成熟食來看，而且下冷凍前要先快速降溫。
spoilage: 薯片結塊黏成一團，倒不出鬆散的粉片。
開袋就聞到陳味、紙板味或淡淡的油耗味。
受潮的袋子出現霉點或霉味。
tips: 開封後倒進氣密罐，紙盒本身不密封。
不要放在熱水壺上方的層架，蒸氣是大敵。
在罐上寫開封日期，薯片老化時幾乎不會給你警告。
剩下的薯泥用淺盤散熱，兩小時內冷藏。

faq.q: 即溶馬鈴薯泥粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 10～15 個月，開封後保持乾燥密封 6～12 個月。
不用，而且冰箱對它來說太潮濕。請密封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃。

faq.q: 沖好的薯泥可以放多久？
faq.a: 那是熟食不是乾貨。快速降溫、兩小時內放進 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在幾天內吃完。
